HDS-001.summary: The byte-pinned official V2.2 publication, visible pages 7-11 and official VDV-301-2.2 release inventory confirm that HDS remains intentionally non-XSD. V2.2 changes access discovery to TXT content+url while retaining canonical _http._tcp; RV-002 confirms the corresponding deterministic resolver behavior.

version_profile.later_v2_2a_transition_note: _ibisip_http._tcp may be accepted with explicit compatibility note only; not native V2.2 source wording

deduplication: No new HDS V2.2 finding ID opened; the independently derived V2.2 profile reconciles to HDS-001 plus version-specific routing behavior.
